meta.zones_note: Only some layers ship drawable zones; the rest are in the choropleth only. A layer with no zone file is still fully available as a number for every area.
meta.note: Screening indicators for comparing areas, not a property-level risk assessment.

coverage.flood: MCF has mapped about 80 watercourses, and the 100-year, 200-year and BHF products do not cover the same ones — 76, 71 and 78 respectively. Coverage is therefore tested per layer: a kommun no record of THAT layer reaches is Not mapped for it, and a covered kommun with no overlap is 0 %.
coverage.landslide: SGU's survey covers part of the territory. An area outside the surveyed extent is Not mapped.

sources: SGU, förutsättningar för skred i finkornig jordart (CC0)
